text: As they ran. <break time="0.8s" /> They heard shots behind them. <break time="0.8s" /> And when they reached the hut. <break time="0.8s" /> There was a brief struggle with its owner. <break time="0.8s" /> Before Arsat could push the canoe. <break time="0.8s" /> Into the water. <break time="0.8s" /> Looking back once. <break time="0.8s" /> Arsat saw his brother running toward them. <break time="0.8s" /> Across the open ground. <break time="0.8s" /> With many men close behind him. <break time="0.8s" /> And he heard him shout, I am coming. <break time="0.8s" /> Then I looked at her, Tuan. <break time="0.8s" /> And I pushed the canoe into deep water. <break time="0.8s" /> Said Arsat. <break time="0.8s" /> And though my brother called my name three times. <break time="0.8s" /> I never turned my head. <break time="0.8s" /> She was there with me. <break time="0.8s" /> And for her I would have faced all men. <break time="0.8s" /> Arsat went on and the white man, after a silence. <break time="0.8s" /> Said quietly, We all love our brothers. <break time="0.8s" /> Arsat cried out. <break time="0.8s" /> That he had only wanted peace in his own heart. <break time="0.8s" /> And then he fell silent. <break time="0.8s" /> While the darkness slowly faded. <break time="0.8s" /> And a white mist covered the lagoon. <break time="0.8s" /> When the sun rose above the trees. <break time="0.8s" /> The mist broke apart. <break time="0.8s" /> And a white eagle rose over the lagoon. <break time="0.8s" /> And soared upward. <break time="0.8s" /> Until it vanished into the bright sky. <break time="0.8s" /> At that moment Arsat stumbled out of the house. <break time="0.8s" /> And stood by the white man. <break time="0.8s" /> And in a dull voice. <break time="0.8s" /> He said only, She burns no more. <break time="0.8s" /> He said that he would neither eat. <break time="0.8s" /> Nor sleep in this house again. <break time="0.8s" /> For he was going back now. <break time="0.8s" /> To where his brother had fallen. <break time="0.8s" /> Though he could see nothing ahead. <break time="0.8s" /> Looking back from his departing boat. <break time="0.8s" /> The white man saw Arsat standing alone. <break time="0.8s" /> In the sunshine. <break time="0.8s" /> Staring through the light of a cloudless day. <break time="0.8s" /> Into the hopeless darkness of the world.
